job.titel: Google Edge Mid Market Delivery Exec
job.beschreibung:
We Are:
We are the Google Edge team—a specialized group of engineers, architects, and builders delivering tailored Google Cloud solutions for mid-market, high-growth, and fast-paced enterprises. We partner with dynamic organizations to connect them with the right combination of Accenture solutions and Google Cloud products to accelerate business transformation and solve real-world problems, quickly. We're expanding our team to meet the unique, rapid execution needs of the Edge segment.
Accenture Edge is Accenture’s purpose-built business serving high-growth mid-market organizations with annual revenues between $300 million and $3 billion. Leveraging the power of AI, data, cloud, and Accenture’s deep industry expertise, Edge helps clients accelerate digital transformation, drive operational excellence, and achieve measurable business outcomes through innovative, scalable, and right-sized solutions tailored to their growth ambitions. By combining industry-leading talent, proven methodologies, and strategic ecosystem partnerships, Accenture Edge enables organizations to reinvent how they operate, enhance customer experiences, and create sustainable value in an increasingly AI-driven world.
To learn more about Accenture Edge, visit: Accenture Edge | Built for Your Scale
The Domain
Applications are the fabric of how modern businesses run — and most companies are stuck on aging platforms that can't keep up. Application modernization on Google Cloud is about more than a lift-and-shift — it's about rearchitecting how companies build, deploy, and scale software. From containerized microservices on GKE to API-first architectures on Apigee to AI-augmented development with Gemini Code Assist, we help clients transform their application estates into modern, cloud-native platforms that move as fast as their business does. Demand is accelerating as companies race to modernize — and our Edge clients need lean, agile leaders who can shape the delivery and drive the transformation
The Work:
You are the kind of leader who lives at the intersection of deep code and big-picture strategy. An enthusiastic, firsthand GCP practitioner, you know that great software isn’t just about elegant architecture, but about solving real-world problems. You are as comfortable personally building a complex solution that harnesses the full power of Google Cloud as you are leading a diverse, high-performing team to a successful launch. With a powerful consultative mindset and a deep curiosity for the 'why,' you convert complex business requirements into brilliant technical solutions. You are an exceptional communicator, an evangelist for modern engineering, and the trusted expert who bridges the gap between a client's vision and its technical reality.
As a GCP delivery executive, you will be a technical and product-centric engineering lead in consulting and engineering projects, customizing Google Cloud solutions for client requirements. You will partner with Accenture's global delivery teams by providing superior technical expertise and product innovation skills. Your role is to execute complex technology solutions for our clients by designing, building, and integrating cloud-native solutions. You will function as a trusted project leader, guiding others in the project team and be the expert on specific Google Cloud technologies/products.  You will build and lead a team of world-class engineers, defining best practices, mentoring their growth, and driving the adoption of modern engineering.
Practice Leadership & People Management: Lead and grow a practice of Google Cloud engineers by managing the workforce, defining best practices, and mentoring team members for professional growth.
Team Leadership & Collaboration: Manage and mentor on-shore and off-shore project teams, conduct reviews, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and delivery excellence.
Product Portfolio: Act as a key technical advisor for sales and delivery, providing technical and functional expertise for our assets and offerings, and collaborate with our offering team to drive continuous innovation
Hands-On Technical Execution: Design, build, test, and deploy complex, cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud, working across the entire service delivery lifecycle from concept to production.
Client-Facing Relationships: Work directly with clients to understand business objectives, translate requirements into solutions, solve unique challenges and act as a technical advisor for the client throughout the project.
Champion of Modern Engineering & Agile Delivery: Drive the adoption of modern engineering and Agile methodologies, coaching the practice to deliver high-quality software at pace.
Multi-Project Delivery & Accountability: Accountable for delivering multiple, concurrent client projects to the highest standard by managing global teams and senior stakeholder relationships.
Expert Delivery across the Google Cloud Ecosystem: Leverage your deep expertise to provide delivery leadership and execute delivery of high-impact solutions in these Google Cloud domains:
Data & AI: Build data pipelines and analytics solutions using BigQuery, Dataflow, and Looker.
Generative & Agentic AI: Contribute to the design and development of AI solutions using Vertex AI, Gemini models, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Security Operations (SecOps) & Cyber Defense: Design and build solutions that integrate with modern security operations platforms. Develop automated response workflows and leverage threat intelligence by using tools such as Google Chronicle Security Operations (SIEM/SOAR), Mandiant, and Security Command Center.
Marketing Intelligence & Personalization: Build data-driven marketing solutions by unifying customer data from multiple sources into Google Cloud. Leverage BigQuery and Vertex AI to develop predictive audience segments and enable hyper-personalized customer experiences across channels.
Customer Engagement (CES): Implement and customize solutions like Contact Center AI (CCaaS) to transform customer experiences.
Application & Infrastructure Modernization: Deliver solutions leveraging Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Apigee, and modern CI/CD practices.
Workplace & Collaboration Solutions: Design and build custom integrations for Google Workspace, using APIs and Google Apps Script to automate workflows and connect productivity tools with enterprise systems.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.
What's in it for you:
Accelerate Your Expertise: Gain early access to cloud innovations and accelerate your expertise in Google Cloud solutions—one of the fastest-growing areas in technology.
Lead Innovative Projects: Work on meaningful projects for clients, powered by the latest Google technologies like Gemini, Vertex AI, and BigQuery
Grow Your Career: Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth, supporting you in expanding your tech stack and earning certifications.
Be Part of a Vibrant Community: Join a diverse, global Accenture/Google community that is continually pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Here's What You'll Need:
Significant experience in a hands-on, client-facing technology role (e.g., Cloud Engineer, Solution Architect, Senior Developer, Technology Consultant).
Practical, hands-on experience architecting and leading the delivery of solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Formal leadership experience, with proven experience managing, coaching, and mentoring technical teams.
Experience leading project teams distributed across the globe and managing multiple concurrent project streams.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
Bonus Points if you have
Consulting experience leading solution delivery, practice management, innovation and stakeholder management
Expertise in product-led engineering, operating models and engineering best practices
Industry and/or functional expertise across one our more solution domains
Deep expertise across the GCP ecosystem, including:
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), and containerization (GKE, Docker).
Data integration using services like Cloud Dataflow or Pub/Sub, API development with Apigee, and working with Google Cloud databases such as Cloud SQL, Spanner, or Bigtable.
Google Chronicle Security Operations, Security Command Center, or other SIEM/SOAR platforms.
Marketing analytics, customer data platforms (CDP), or building solutions for marketing and sales
Experience with Google Workspace APIs and Google Apps Script for building custom integrations and automations.
Hands-on experience with Google CES (CCaaS) or other contact center technologies (e.g., Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect).
Multiple Google Cloud Professional certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer).
